name: CUE Splitter
description: Shows the tracks of single-file album images (FLAC, APE, WavPack, WAV...) described by a .cue sheet as individual songs, without splitting or modifying the original file. Tracks are decoded on the fly, sample-accurately.

versions.changelog:
Publish as a Jellyfin plugin repository

- Release workflow: on a vX.Y.Z.W tag, build with that version, attach
  the zip to a GitHub release and add the version (URL, MD5 checksum,
  targetAbi) to manifest.json on main
- scripts/update_manifest.py to maintain the repository manifest
- Delete the virtual tracks when the plugin is uninstalled, since
  Jellyfin only removes file-backed items by itself
- README: installation through the plugin repository, manual install,
  uninstall and release procedure
